title: Chapter 1241 - 4: Backlash From The Timeline (Seeking Subscription)

Chapter 1241 - 4: Backlash From The Timeline (Seeking Subscription)

Chapter 1241: Chapter 4: Backlash from the Timeline (Seeking Subscription)

"Very high?"

"How high is very high?"

Lin Yuan asked curiously.

"You just need to know it’s very high." The Ancestor of Fierce Sun said.

He wasn’t sure about Lin Yuan’s chances of stepping into the Shisan Rank specifically, only that of the hundreds of timelines he observed, the other had stepped into the Shisan Rank.

But hundreds of timelines stepping into the Shisan Rank does not mean all timelines can, as the Ancestor of Fierce Sun can’t observe all timelines. Even for a Shisan Rank time-being, what they can observe is only a portion of timelines.

To observe all timelines would be a dimension that Perfect Time Beings of the Fourteen Rank could reach.

"Before taking that step, if you have any questions, feel free to find me."

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun looked at Lin Yuan: "To find me, just call out the words ’Fierce Sun’."

As a time-being, the title integrates with the spacetime of heaven and earth. As long as someone mentions the words ’Fierce Sun,’ the Ancestor of Fierce Sun will sense it.

However, the Ancestor of Fierce Sun generally doesn’t bother with these, but if Lin Yuan were to call out the words ’Fierce Sun,’ the Ancestor of Fierce Sun would certainly appear immediately.

"Thank you, Ancestor."

Lin Yuan’s tone was slightly emotional.

So far, Lin Yuan has browsed through many accumulations of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, and he has never heard of such a Peak Venerable having the means to summon the Ancestor at any time.

Even the Emperor cannot do it; they must go through a certain ’intermediate rank’ to contact the Ancestor, while Lin Yuan can contact directly? It’s unprecedented.

"It’s nothing."

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun smiled at Lin Yuan: "I look forward to the birth of the seventh Ancestor in this world, creating the seventh great ancient country."

Swoosh.

Lin Yuan only felt a change in spacetime and once again returned to the grand hall of the palace.

"Galaxy?"

The Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country sat on the throne, surprised by Lin Yuan’s appearance.

Normally, the Peak Venerables who go to the Mysterious Space to possess the Ancestor take at least several months to return.

Slower ones can take decades or even centuries.

For Lin Yuan to return after less than half an hour in that Mysterious Space is something the Emperor had never heard of.

"I did not possess."

Lin Yuan said directly.

"Did not possess?" The Emperor blinked.

He went to the Mysterious Space, summoned the Ancestor, and could still refuse possession midway?

"The Ancestor told me not to possess for the time being." Lin Yuan explained.

"The Ancestor told you not to possess for now?" The Emperor’s expression was thoughtful.

"The Ancestor said I don’t need to rush into possession, to wait until taking that step before coming back for possession."

Lin Yuan said.

The Emperor pondered for a moment, then nodded: "The Ancestor’s words surely have reason."

"But about your trillion merits..." The Emperor looked at Lin Yuan; before entering the Mysterious Space, Lin Yuan exchanged his opportunity to possess the Ancestor, sacrificing trillion merits.

This merit exchange channel is difficult to retrace, decided by the soul of the capital city.

"No need, the Ancestor says I can now freely receive guidance from the treasures within the treasury." Lin Yuan said.

This could not be hidden from the Emperor, as the Emperor of the ancient country had the right to query the exchanges in the treasury, Lin Yuan had just swapped for the chance to possess the Ancestor, and the Emperor knew.

"Freely receive guidance from the treasures within the treasury?" The Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country looked at Lin Yuan, momentarily silent.

This is tantamount to the ancient country’s treasury fully opening to Lin Yuan; knowing that for the high and mighty Ancestor of Fierce Sun, they have never interfered with the ancient country’s governance, yet making an exception for Lin Yuan...

The Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country was naturally shocked.

"Then I’ll head back first." Lin Yuan continued chatting a bit with the Emperor, then got up to bid farewell.

The Emperor watched Lin Yuan disappear, his face returning to calmness.

"The Ancestor views the Galaxy so differently, even breaking the rules..." The Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country thought deeply.

As the Emperor of the ancient country, he clearly knew the height of the Ancestor, Lin Yuan indeed had terrifying talent, becoming the first Invincible Venerable in the history of the six great ancient countries.

But so what? If he doesn’t reach the Shisan Rank, he still wouldn’t be on the Ancestor’s radar or be significant to the Ancestor.

Yet Lin Yuan received such treatment from the Ancestor, making the Emperor’s thoughts wander.

"All are ants beneath the Ancestor, to have the Ancestor break rules, only a being equal to the Ancestor could..."

The Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country looked towards the direction Lin Yuan left, waves surged in his heart: "Ancestor?"

...

Returning to the Galaxy Royal Mansion.

Lin Yuan immediately focused his mind to enter the treasury.

"View all nine supreme inheritances." Lin Yuan immediately began to look at the specific content of the nine supreme inheritances.

Initially, Lin Yuan had already dismissed three of them because these three supreme inheritances involved various hidden hazards, which Lin Yuan couldn’t accept, so naturally, he wouldn’t exchange for them.

But now?

Knowing he could freely exchange for any guidance from the inheritances, Lin Yuan naturally wouldn’t miss the chance to look at these three inheritances.

Even if not cultivating, observing and referencing them, as supreme inheritances, which are the Shisan Rank inheritances of the Chaos Void, even if full of hidden dangers, surely have great reference value.

Lin Yuan certainly wouldn’t miss them.

"’Fierce Sun Heart’..."

Lin Yuan roughly browsed this supreme inheritance, condensing a heart with half a step into the Shisan Rank, thereby gaining power far exceeding the limit of the Twelfth Rank. The terrifying extent of this inheritance was beyond Lin Yuan’s imagination.

"Cultivate to perfection and completely transform one’s heart into the Fierce Sun Heart; strength is likely not much weaker than the Xuanhuang with half a step into the Twelfth Rank." Lin Yuan thought.

Of course, cultivating ’Fierce Sun Heart’ to perfection is extremely difficult, requiring extremely rich Ancestor bloodline, and even at critical moments, must absorb a drop of Ancestor’s essence blood to transform one’s heart.

As for a drop of Ancestor’s essence blood... it’s not a matter of merit, as the essence blood of a time-being, even if its killing intent is wiped away, how many beings below the Shisan Rank can endure it?

"This inheritance, although I won’t practice it, some of its concepts can be referenced, especially in using the power of the thirteen levels..."

Lin Yuan was full of spirit, having watched all eight supreme inheritances, gaining substantial insights, with many flashes of inspiration flooding his mind.

...

"Although the Ancestor said my prospects of entering the Thirteen Levels is high, I can’t be complacent."

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, realizing how rare it was for a Time Life to make such a remark, yet the more exceptional it was, the more vigilant Lin Yuan felt.

The so-called high possibility of entering the Thirteen Levels does not mean foolproof. The greater the hope, if it ultimately fails, wouldn’t all the initial investment be wasted?

Lin Yuan naturally did not want to end up that way.

"Things should be handled as they should."

"I can’t relax just because of the Ancestor’s evaluation."

"The Martial Arts Evolution Road branch still needs to be spread out."

Lin Yuan thought quickly to himself, even if stepping into the Thirteen Levels seems very hopeful, maximizing everything else is not a bad thing.

...

Mysterious Space.

After Lin Yuan returned, the Ancestor of Fierce Sun did not disappear as usual.

Instead, he continued to observe Lin Yuan.

"In the one thousand three hundred sixty-eight timelines, all still culminate in the Thirteen Levels?"

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun was not idling; he continued watching Lin Yuan’s timelines.

The more he watched, the more intense the shock in his heart became.

"Forget it, don’t continue branching out the timelines, rather delve into a particular timeline."

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun thought, at present, of the more than a thousand timelines he observed, each timeline ceased when Lin Yuan stepped into the Thirteen Levels.

Because a timeline, once it involves Thirteen Levels, becomes exponentially difficult to watch.

Thus, Fierce Sun Ancestor didn’t watch recklessly.

After observing over a thousand timelines with no variation in the outcome, he decided to see how far Lin Yuan could truly grow.

Entering the Thirteen Levels is not the focus; even among Thirteen Level Time Lives, there are distinctions between strength and weakness. Powerful Time Lives can discern more future timelines, their strategies silently yet profoundly impactful.

For Time Lives, intertwining is not confined to power but depends on how much they can perceive.

The more timelines they can see, the more future possibilities they wield, thus the stronger they become.

Fierce Sun Ancestor collected his thoughts, immediately delving into a timeline to watch.

The timeline unfolded, quickly reaching when Lin Yuan advanced into the Thirteen Levels.

Scene after scene appeared in the Ancestor of Fierce Sun’s view.

It was a dark and lifeless space.

A young man sat cross-legged, overhead a massive Black and White Yin Yang Taiji Diagram, spanning time and space, encompassing past, present, future, countless future possibilities converging, advancing towards the future desired by the young man.

Below the Taiji Diagram, an existence filled with endless spiritual light roared in anger.

The existence of endless spiritual light seemed to be the source of all life, its presence constantly influencing the surrounding time and space, yet at this moment, being suppressed by the young man.

"Galaxy, I give up the layout from one hundred eighty million billion years henceforth. That dimensional creation is yours." The existence of endless spiritual light conceded.

...

"Da Ling..." The Ancestor of Fierce Sun’s heart trembled slightly seeing this scene.

The existence of endless spiritual light, the Da Ling Ancestor, was the Time Life second only to Da Fu Ancestor among the current six great ancestors.

Yet in the future scene, the Da Ling Ancestor was suppressed tightly by the young man, even forced to abandon his strategic future layout.

...

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun paused for a moment, continuing to observe further into the future.

...

A majestic man filled with the aura of the world’s origin, terrifying movements enough to shake the entire source world, yet at this moment, the majestic man was fleeing, even compelled to smash open dimension cracks, escaping to unknown other dimensions.

But immediately after, a Black and White Yin Yang Taiji Diagram enveloped, vast and extensive, influencing timelines.

"Da Fu."

The young man looked down from above, overlooking the majestic man below.

...

"Da Fu is fleeing too?"

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun was shocked, among the six great ancestors, Da Fu Ancestor was undisputedly the strongest ancestor, yet in the future scene, as strong as Da Fu Ancestor, was being chased down by Lin Yuan, fleeing in panic, ultimately unable to escape?

...

"After reaching the Thirteen Levels, growth speed can still be this fast?"

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun found it unbelievable; the cultivation at the Thirteen Levels differs entirely from the Twelfth Levels, and Lin Yuan’s rapid advancement at the Twelfth Level doesn’t guarantee the same at the Thirteen Levels.

Even if rapid advancement continues, hunting down Da Fu Ancestor who flees in panic, this is beyond rapid advancement.

...

"Keep watching."

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun couldn’t help continuing to watch further into the future.

However, just as Fierce Sun Ancestor observed much farther into the future, he felt a profound gaze cast towards him.

Boom!!!

Fierce Sun Ancestor felt his mental state shake, consciousness uncontrollably becoming muddled.

...

...
